notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch via probe.fetch (curl_cffi), HTTP 200 on every request, no proxy. Shopify storefront (bloomr-dubai.myshopify.com), country AE, English is the default locale (/ar, /ru and /de are sub-locales), so canonical English /collections/<handle> URLs were used; the recorded URL's own <link rel=canonical> is https://www.bloomr.com/collections/bathroom-accessories, i.e. no redirect. robots.txt is Shopify's agent-aware file: it names no Claude / anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot agent and User-agent:* is Allow:/ for product, collection, page and blog HTML; only /admin and transactional paths are disallowed. Its header text asks agents not to complete checkout or payment - nothing of the sort was attempted; only public collection HTML and the public products.json feeds were read. TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu in the homepage HTML (169 distinct /collections/ anchors parsed) and cross-checked against the full collection sitemap https://www.bloomr.com/sitemap_collections_1.xml (316 collections). Bloomr is primarily an artificial-flowers, trees, plants and stems retailer; the top-level menus are Artificial Flowers & Orchids, Artificial Trees, Artificial Plants, Artificial Stems, Home Decor, Lighting, Bedlinen & Towels, Tableware, Rugs, Furniture and Summer Sale. CONTRARY TO THE EXPECTATION THAT BLOOMR MIGHT HAVE NO BATHROOM AT ALL, it does carry exactly one genuine bathroom node: 'Bathroom Accessories' (/collections/bathroom-accessories), which the mega-menu lists as the last child of the Home Decor menu (verified in the raw menu markup: it follows Baskets & Rattan inside the Home Decor <details> block). It is a flat Shopify collection with no child collections, so it is the deepest valid listing and is recorded as a leaf. There is no Bathroom department, no sanitaryware, baths, showers, enclosures, taps, toilets, basins, vanity units or bathroom cabinets anywhere on the site - grepping all 316 sitemap collection handles for bath|shower|toilet|sanitar|vanity|basin|sink|tap|faucet|wash|soap|robe returned only bathroom-accessories, bedlinen-towels and towels. QTY: the storefront's own rendered listing header, div id='ProductCount' -> '1-8 of 8 products'. The Shopify structured products_count was NOT used as the source. VERIFICATION: (a) independent enumeration - /collections/bathroom-accessories/products.json?limit=250 returned exactly 8 products, matching the header; (b) last-page boundary proven - ?page=2 renders no ProductCount block and zero product tiles; (c) H1 is 'Bathroom Accessories', matching the node requested, and the final URL equals the requested URL (canonical self-referencing, no redirect); (d) the number discriminates - the sibling Mirrors collection reports '1-48 of 113 products' and Towels '1-3 of 3 products' on the same template, so 8 is not a constant or a site total. COMPOSITION OF THE RECORDED LEAF (full disclosure, no product-level splitting was applied): the 8 products are 5 marble bathroom accessory sets (Zomaum, Namale, Dysoga, Kalyk, Fyfo - all tagged 'Bathroom Accessories' / 'Marble Bathroom Accessories Set', product_type Home Decor) plus the 3 'Towel' products (product_type TOWELS) that Shopify cross-lists into this collection from Bedlinen & Towels. Per rule 26 the recorded qty is the listing page's own rendered total for the node (8); the Towels collection itself is routed to Textile separately, and the two records are distinct URLs so this is not a duplicate under rule 28. EXCLUDED: /collections/mirrors (113 products) plus its shape and promotional variants /collections/landscape-mirrors, /portrait-mirrors, /round-mirrors, /square-mirrors, /mirrors-sale, /mirrors-outlet - these are decorative wall mirrors inside the Home Decor menu with no bathroom framing (rules 10/11/29 - primary type is decorative mirror, hierarchy is Home Decor), so they stay with Home Decor and were not duplicated here; the shape ones are facet collections and the sale/outlet ones are promotional (rule 25). /collections/bedlinen-towels is a 'View All' department node (rule 25). Lighting on this site is Chandeliers & Pendant Lamps, Floor Lamps, Table Lamps and Wall Lamps & Sconces - there is no bathroom / vanity / mirror light node, so nothing was routed to Lighting. Baskets & Rattan, Decorative Trays, Decorative Boxes, Jars and Candles are general Home Decor / Storage and were not pulled in on keyword (rules 30-33).
